title: Musiał i Wspólnicy — internal application
summary: An internal law firm application that automates repetitive tasks. The client reports that some now take 80% less time.
portfolioImageAlt: Musiał i Wspólnicy law firm logo

blocks.text:
Musiał i Wspólnicy is a Poznań-based law firm specialising in services for businesses, companies and institutions.

The firm asked whether I could create a tool to speed up one of its repetitive tasks.

After discussing their needs and mapping the process, I proposed an internal application to serve as a hub for collaboration across the firm.

The application is modular. New modules are added when the firm identifies another need. Each module addresses one specific problem and is built specifically for the firm’s requirements.

The client reports that some tasks now take 80% less time than before the application was introduced, because the team does much less manual work.
